pages.text: TWENTY STUDIO LAB Home Chi siamo Servizi I nostri lavori Contatti Shop Più Menu ABOUT TWENTY STUDIO LAB Founded in May 2018 by the creative minds of Giulia De Salvia and Chiara Guzzon, TWENTY STUDIO LAB was born as a space for research and experimentation in the world of fashion. The studio blends creativity, design, and technical expertise, the result of years of experience in the Italian textile industry and a deep shared passion: transforming ideas into images, and images into collections. At the heart of the project lies the power of drawing — the starting point and guiding thread of every creative process. Each line tells an intuition, each stroke shapes a vision: a visual language made of color, balance, and detail, turning creativity into style. A constant pursuit of trends, combined with an ever-evolving aesthetic sensibility, allows TWENTY STUDIO LAB to create contemporary and distinctive projects, collaborating with fashion brands and companies all over the world. Chi siamo WHERE CREATIVITY SPEAKS Creativity is the beating heart of our collections. Endless travels, research, and curiosity let us connect with every world, every client. Bold ideas, designs that speak for themselves. Hai bisogno di contattarci? Chi siamo :: TWENTY STUDIO LAB Home Chi siamo Servizi I nostri lavori Contatti Shop Più Menu Who We Are Giulia De Salvia She studied Fashion and Textile Design at the Istituto Europeo di Design (IED) in Turin. Curious and determined, Giulia combines a dynamic personality with a tenacious drive to achieve every goal she sets for herself. Her lively and creative mind is constantly inspired by every form of art, turning curiosity into a continuous source of innovation. Chiara Guzzon With decades of experience in the textile industry, Chiara has built a versatile and adaptive professional profile — a true chameleon of creativity. She balances her realistic mindset with a visionary and entrepreneurial spirit, embodying the duality of a dreamer whose feet remain firmly on the ground. TWENTY STUDIO LAB creates exclusive designs and unique collections, rooted in a deep study of color, fashion, and trends. Each pattern is born from a blend of hand-drawing and digital techniques, crafted with care and precision to produce harmonious, elegant, and original creations designed to inspire and captivate. Servizi :: TWENTY STUDIO LAB Home Chi siamo Servizi I nostri lavori Contatti Shop Più Menu Services TWENTY STUDIO LAB produces new designs and updated collections every day, inspired by current trends and research. We offer exclusive designs on request, working closely with clients, and creative consulting services for textile industries and capsule collections. With over 15 years of experience in the textile industry, we specialize in pattern variation, customized design variants, and pattern alignment, combining technical precision with aesthetic excellence in every project . TREND HUNTERS We travel, observe, and study global markets to uncover emerging trends. Every collection starts from a deep analysis of the latest colors, materials, and tastes. HANDCRAFTED DESIGN From idea to design: we craft every piece with artisanal care, blending creativity and research to create unique, standout prints. Additionally, we develop collections of designs that we showcase through our agents worldwide. ATYLE CONSULTANCY We partner with companies to understand their markets and clients, designing tailor-made collections that speak directly to their audience. I nostri lavori :: TWENTY STUDIO LAB Home Chi siamo Servizi I nostri lavori Contatti Shop Più Menu Our collections come to life through the meeting of inspiration, research, and aesthetic sensitivity. Each design is born from a careful study of trends, combined with meticulous color research and thoughtfully curated pairings. Nothing is left to chance: every detail is designed to create balance, character, and a distinctive style that stands out and inspires emotion. Bespoke Collections Every brand has a story to tell. We translate it into shapes, colors, and moods. You can contact us to co-create an exclusive collection, tailor-made and enhanced with custom color variations to suit your needs. Alternatively, you can purchase existing designs directly from our platform, selecting from our available collections. From Idea to Final Product Ma Vie Ma Vie represents what happens when ideas are nurtured with vision and transformed through design. It is a journey that begins with a message — the desire to communicate meaning through print — and evolves into a finished garment with a strong, authentic identity. We believe print can be more than an aesthetic element: it can speak, inspire, and carry values. Through the illustration of iconic women, we created a narrative in which every woman can see herself reflected, finding inspiration, connection, and strength within the stories being told. This is how we work: by translating concepts into visuals, and visuals into products that resonate. We collaborate with brands that seek depth, storytelling, and distinction — shaping ideas into collections with purpose and soul.
